mintAuthority.summary: EUROP uses UUPS token proxies on Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, and Plasma, Schuman's issuer account on XRPL, and a Token-2022 mint on Solana. The EVM deployments use chain-local admin and master-minter Safes; XRPL uses its issuer quorum; Solana uses a 1-of-3 Token-2022 mint-authority multisig.

controls.label: EUROP Ethereum MASTER_MINTER_ROLE Safe
controls.capDescription: MASTER_MINTER_ROLE bypasses the per-minter allowance in mint(); the Safe can also administer minter allowances.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530884, this 2-of-4 Safe was the sole MASTER_MINTER_ROLE member. EUROPToken.mint() permits MASTER_MINTER_ROLE callers to mint without consuming minterAllowed.

controls.label: EUROP Solana Token-2022 mint-authority multisig
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 434569236, getAccountInfo(jsonParsed) identifies EUROP mint euro5sNHrZC2wu2RoLvy6xxoVMc3Qnd1vjxoWf4MftA as a 6-decimal Token-2022 mint with mintAuthority 3t3X4xqXbRDksat5cPjfHoWftvTwpHEj9c7tWMVvNPAh. The authority account parses as an initialized Token-2022 multisig requiring 1 of 3 valid signers; it can authorize direct minting without an on-chain numeric cap.

controls.label: EUROP XRPL issuer account

sources.label: XRPL native multi-signing and weighted quorum semantics

controls.evidence: At validated XRPL ledger 107367076 (hash 8B4EC40E70B8C609CC954472238EDB2656F4E111CF14819EF57DEDE111A176F0), account_info reports the master key disabled, no RegularKey, and a signer list with weighted quorum 3 across six signers (weights 1,1,1,3,1,1). Signer rMRvXUPc8cWPPYCBP2dWAWtAwSq3rjTSpi alone has weight 3 and satisfies the quorum; this is not a 3-of-6 signature requirement. Schuman's official deployment page binds this account to EUROP issuance. weightedQuorum represents the native SignerList exactly without uniform threshold/signerCount or human-independence/key-custody credit. The signing identity is SHA-256 of JSON.stringify({issuer,quorum,signers,masterKey,regularKey}) with signers sorted by account.localeCompare. No complete execution-scope or off-chain operational-security certificate is asserted.

review.evidence: Historical pinned control reads cover the six published EUROP deployments: Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche and Plasma use UUPS token proxies with chain-local owner/admin and MASTER_MINTER_ROLE Safes; XRPL uses Schuman's issuer account; at finalized Solana slot 434569236 the Token-2022 mint authority is an initialized 1-of-3 multisig. These issuance surfaces remain economically unbounded issuer controls. The prior ESMA SALVUS/ACPR supervision evidence is retained without claiming a new licence review. Reconciliation reviewed 2026-10-05: Schuman Platform T&Cs v1.1 section 7.4 states that Schuman performs daily reconciliation of all vIBANs, Reserve Accounts and Token balances. Sections 4.1 and 7.1 connect receipt of fiat, minting, token burns and fiat releases; section 7.5 identifies the internal treasury system as the process operator. Section 3 explicitly includes all six currently published networks, including XRPL and Solana. This establishes a daily issuer-operated supply/backing reconciliation cadence, not continuous or independent six-chain assurance. The June 30 KPMG examination covers only four EVM chains and is not used to extend independent assurance to XRPL/Solana.
